basis_object.description: Basis Object (structured). The value of the BasisObject form component { basis_type, basis }: basis_type comes from ref billing_basis_type (e.g. market / currency / billing item), and basis is the concrete value (market uses global_market, currency uses global_currency_filter_by_account_channel, billing item is plain text).. Options: `1` = Market; `2` = Currency; `3` = Counter ID

basis_type.description: Basis Type. A top-level field expanded from basis_object.basis_type on submit, matching the value inside basis_object.

basis.description: Basis Value. A top-level field expanded from basis_object.basis at submission time.

direction.description: Fee Direction. The enum comes from ref billing_item_direction; the options are filtered by the bizMap corresponding to biz_type.. Options: `1` = Match Trade Buy/Transfer Out/No Direction; `2` = Match Trade Sell/Transfer In; `3` = Match All

divisor.description: Divisor. Dropdown options generated by filtering bizMap's allow_options for the given biz_type.

metric_type.description: Metric Type. Enum from ref billing_metric_type, filtered by the bizMap corresponding to biz_type.. Options: `1` = Transaction Quantity(Fractional support); `2` = Transaction Amount/Other Amount; `3` = Single Billing By Corresponding granularity; `4` = Options Quantity; `5` = Upstream; `6` = Number Of Billing Contracts; `7` = Number Of Orders; `8` = Number Of Transactions; `9` = Value Of Positions; `10` = Calculation Based On Existing Scenarios; `11` = Market Value Of Securities Lending; `13` = Transaction Quantity Of Board Lot (Transfer Warehouse); `14` = Market Value (Transfer Warehouse); `15` = Number of Ems Orders

metric_type_bill_amount_item_ids.description: Secondary Bill Amount Item IDs. Required only when metric_type = calculation based on existing scenarios (BillingMetricType.CalculationBasedOnExistingScenarios); comes from the multi-select result of the templateId=billing_item_for_secondary_item table.

granularity.description: Granularity. Values come from ref billing_granularity, filtered by biz_type via bizMap.. Options: `1` = Contract; `2` = Order; `3` = Trade Done; `4` = Ems Order

benchmark_rate.description: Benchmark Rate Formula. Shown only when the bizMap for the given biz_type has a benchmark_rate config; a plain number with up to 10 decimal places.

cutoff_object.description: Cutoff Object (structured). { cutoff_method, cutoff_digits }; the cutoff_method enum comes from ref billing_fee_cutoff_method.. Options: `1` = Round; `2` = Round Up; `3` = Round Down

put.description: The "Submit" button on the Contract Amendments page. After selecting an old contract, the user edits bills/discounts/position-migration information across the Fees and Holdings tabs and submits to generate a new contract. mm_factor.description: Maintenance Margin Factor. Taken from the list row's record.mm_factor; like im_factor, it is divided by 100 before submission.
